title: Formula for the connecting morphism of a split short exact sequence of complexes
statement: Let 0 \to K_1^\bullet \to K_2^\bullet \to K_3^\bullet \to 0 be a degreewise split short exact sequence of cochain complexes in an abelian category [def-sp-abelian], with degreewise sections s from K_3 to K_2 and retractions pi from K_2 to K_1. The connecting morphism from H n of K_3 to H n+1 of K_1 in the long exact homology sequence [lem-weil-pbc-complex-ses-homology-long-exact] sends a cocycle represented by z in K_3 in degree n to the cohomology class represented by pi in degree n+1 applied to the differential in K_2 of s in degree n applied to z.
